drawings.description: sphère vue en perspective ; sur l'équateur, trois points marqués (ronds pleins), chacun entouré d'un petit cercle portant deux sommets $R_i^{\omega}$, $R_i^{\omega'}$ ($i = 0, 1, \infty$), reliés par les arcs $a_i^{\omega}$, $a_i^{\omega'}$ ; les sommets voisins de deux points différents sont reliés par les flèches $b_0^{\omega}$, $b_1^{\omega}$ (lecture douteuse), $b_\infty^{\omega}$. Légende : $\mathrm{I}_J$.
drawings.kind: sphere with marked points, small circles and arrows
drawings.notes: Sphere outline and equator in pencil; the three marked points (big dots) on the equator, each in a small oriented circle with two vertices R_i^omega, R_i^omega'. Arrows b along the equator between the circles. The label of the right-hand b arrow is overinked; it is placed as the transcription reads it (b_1^omega, doubtful). The point near the north pole is drawn.

drawings.description: même sphère que p.~23, à laquelle s'ajoutent sur l'équateur trois nouveaux sommets $Q_0$, $Q_1$, $Q_\infty$ et des arcs $c_i^{\pm}$ qui les relient aux sommets $R^{\pm}$ voisins. Légende : $\mathrm{II}_J$.
drawings.kind: sphere with marked points, small circles and arrows
drawings.notes: As 02-1 with the signs +/- for omega, omega'; the new vertices Q_0, Q_1, Q_infty on the equator and the arrows c_i^+- joining them to the R. The legend II_J (below-left of the sphere) is text, not drawn. Q_1 sits at the left end of the equator, its label being c_1^+ there.

drawings.description: à droite : petit schéma de $\tilde a_i^{\omega}$, chemin de $Q_{\omega i}$ à $Q_{\omega' i}$ passant par $(c^{\omega}_{\omega i})^{-1}$, l'arc $a_i^{\omega}$ entre $R_i^{\omega}$ et $R_i^{\omega'}$, puis $c^{\omega'}_{\omega' i}$ ; une première version, au-dessous, est rayée. Dans la marge gauche, un croquis analogue, en partie rayé.
drawings.kind: path diagram (composite arc)
drawings.notes: Right: Q_{omega i} on the left, Q_{omega' i} on the right; (c^omega_{omega i})^{-1} as an arrow to Q_{omega i}, the arc a_i^omega looping above between R_i^omega and R_i^omega', and c^{omega'}_{omega' i} as an arrow towards Q_{omega' i}. The struck first version below it is shown only as two grey strokes (it is overinked and crossed out). Left margin: the two elongated loops of the analogous sketch, in pencil; its small labels are not legible and are left out.

figures.what: left margin: analogous sketch, partly struck

drawings.description: à gauche : sphère portant les trois sommets $Q_0$, $Q_1$, $Q_\infty$ et les six arcs $\tilde a_i^{\pm}$ qui les joignent deux à deux. Légende : $\mathrm{III}_J$.
drawings.kind: sphere with three vertices and six arcs
drawings.notes: Sphere in pencil; Q_1 (left), Q_infty (middle), Q_0 (right) on the front, joined pairwise by two arcs each: a lens Q_1-Q_infty, a lens Q_infty-Q_0, and an arc Q_1-Q_0 over the top (dotted); the sixth arc (tilde a_infty^-, Q_1-Q_0) is drawn by him across the middle, overinked. Arrowheads are approximate. Legend III_J and (27) are text.

drawings.description: à droite : $Q_{\omega i}$ et $Q_{\omega' i}$ reliés par les deux arcs $\tilde a_i^{\omega}$ (en haut) et $\tilde a_i^{\omega'}$ (en bas) ; au centre, en pointillé, le petit cercle $R_i^{\omega}$, $R_i^{\omega'}$ et l'arc $a_i^{\omega}$.
drawings.kind: two arcs between two vertices around a small circle
drawings.notes: Q_{omega i} (left) and Q_{omega' i} (right) joined by tilde a_i^omega above (arrow to the left) and tilde a_i^{omega'} below (arrow to the right); in the middle, dotted, the small circle through R_i^{omega'}, R_i^omega with the arc a_i^omega, and dotted segments from the Q to the R. The line of text above the figure is not drawn.

drawings.description: sphère : pôles $P_{+}$ (en haut) et $P_{-}$ (en bas) ; sur l'équateur, les sommets $Q_0$, $Q_1$, $Q_\infty$ et les trois points marqués (ronds pleins) ; les arcs $\tilde a_i^{\pm}$ le long de l'équateur, et les méridiens $d_i^{+}$ (de $P_{+}$ à $Q_i$) et $d_i^{-}$ (de $P_{-}$ à $Q_i$), en trait plein ou en pointillé selon qu'ils sont vus ou cachés.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians and equatorial vertices
drawings.notes: Pencil outline; P_+ above, P_- below; on the equator Q_infty, Q_0, Q_1 and the three marked points (big dots). Seen arcs solid, hidden ones dashed, as on the page. The arcs tilde a along the equator are drawn as his strokes go; the label in the middle reads tilde a_0^+ (as does the one at the right edge, which is left out as a probable doubling). The scribbled text above the sphere is not drawn.

drawings.description: sphère avec les pôles $P_{+}$, $P_{-}$, les trois points marqués sur l'équateur et les méridiens $d_0^{\pm}$, $d_1^{\pm}$, $d_\infty^{\pm}$. Légende : $\mathrm{V}_J$.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles and meridians
drawings.notes: Pencil outline and equator; P_+ at the top, P_- at the bottom; the front meridian d_0 solid, d_infty and d_1 dashed (hidden); the three marked points on the equator (the left one ringed). Each meridian carries d_i^- above and d_i^+ below, as he labels them. Legend V_J (text) not drawn.

drawings.description: sphère réunissant les figures précédentes : pôles $P^{+}$, $P^{-}$ ; sur l'équateur, $Q_0$, $Q_1$, $Q_\infty$ et, autour de chacun des trois points marqués, le petit cercle $R_i^{\pm}$ avec les arcs $a_i^{\pm}$ ; les arcs $c_i^{\pm}$ joignant les $Q$ aux $R$, et les méridiens $d_i^{\pm}$. Légende : $\mathrm{VI}$.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians, equatorial vertices and small circles
drawings.notes: Pencil outline; P^+ and P^-; meridians d_infty (dashed above Q_infty), d_0 (solid), d_1 (dashed), each with d^+ above and d^- below; Q_infty, Q_0, Q_1; the small circles round the marked points (dotted round 0, solid round 1 and infinity) with R^+-, a^+-; arrows c^+- from the Q to the R. His doubled pencil strokes at the bottom left and bottom right are reduced to one; the hatching near P^- is not drawn.

drawings.description: en bas à gauche : petit triangle $P^{\omega}$, $Q_{\omega i}$, $R_i^{\omega'}$ ; arcs $d^{\omega}_{\omega i}$ de $P^{\omega}$ à $Q_{\omega i}$, $c^{\omega}_{\omega i}$ de $Q_{\omega i}$ à $R_i^{\omega'}$, et le chemin composé $\tilde d_i'^{\omega}$ ; une boucle autour de $R_i^{\omega'}$.
drawings.kind: small path triangle
drawings.notes: P^omega at the top, Q_{omega i} bottom left, R_i^{omega'} bottom right; d^omega_{omega i} from P^omega to Q_{omega i}, c^omega_{omega i} from Q_{omega i} to R_i^{omega'}, the composite tilde d_i'^omega dashed from P^omega to R_i^{omega'}; the loop round R_i^{omega'} is cut by the page edge on the right.

drawings.description: à gauche : $P^{\omega}$ en haut, $Q_{\omega' i}$ en bas, $R_i^{\omega}$ à gauche ; flèche $d^{\omega}_{\omega' i}$ de $P^{\omega}$ à $Q_{\omega' i}$, arc $c^{\omega'}_{\omega' i}$ de $Q_{\omega' i}$ à $R_i^{\omega}$, et en pointillé le chemin composé.
drawings.kind: small path triangle
drawings.notes: P^omega at the top, Q_{omega' i} at the bottom, R_i^omega on the left; d^omega_{omega' i} from P^omega down to Q_{omega' i}, c^{omega'}_{omega' i} from Q_{omega' i} to R_i^omega, the composite path dashed from P^omega to R_i^omega. The number (66) on the right is text.

drawings.description: sphère : les deux pôles, les huit sommets $R_i^{\omega}$, $P^{\omega}$, et les arcs $d_i^{\omega}$, $d_i'^{\omega}$ (méridiens, pleins ou pointillés), $a_i^{\omega}$ (petits cercles) et $b_i^{\omega}$ (le long de l'équateur). Légende : $\mathrm{VII}$.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians and small circles
drawings.notes: Pencil outline; the two poles joined by six meridians (four solid, two dashed); the equator; the three small circles on it (the middle one behind), with two vertices each; arrows along the meridians and the equator. No labels on the figure itself (the NB in the left margin is text). Arrowheads are approximate and several are left out; the transcription speaks of eight vertices R_i^omega, P^omega: drawn are 2 poles and 6 vertices on the circles.

drawings.description: seconde sphère, au crayon : les deux pôles reliés par trois méridiens, les trois points marqués sur l'équateur. Légende : $\mathrm{VIII} = \mathrm{IV}$.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles and meridians
drawings.notes: All in faint pencil: outline, equator, the two poles joined by three meridians (one in front, two near the outline), the three marked points on the equator. The legend VIII = IV is text, not drawn.

drawings.description: sphère : pôles $P^{+}$, $P^{-}$ ; autour des trois points marqués, les petits cercles $R_i^{\pm}$ avec les arcs $a_i^{\pm}$ ; les méridiens $\tilde d_i^{\pm}$ et $\tilde d_i'^{\pm}$ ($i = 0, 1, \infty$) descendant des pôles vers les $R$, en trait plein ou pointillé selon qu'ils sont vus ou cachés.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians and small circles
drawings.notes: Pencil outer outline and the inked front outline; P^+ and P^-; meridians tilde d_i^+-, tilde d_i'^+- from the poles down to the R (solid when seen, dashed when hidden); the small circles round the marked points (left: R_1^-, R_1^+, a_1^+-; middle: R_0^+, R_0^-, a_0^+-; right one cut by the outline); the dashed equator. Several arrowheads and the exact course of the meridians below the equator are approximate; the label at the right edge (tilde d_infty^+) is partly cut.

drawings.description: une sphère, pôles $P^{+}$ en haut et $P^{-}$ en bas, l'équateur $\Sigma_{\mathbf{R}}$ portant les trois trous $R_0$, $R_1$, $R_\infty$, chacun entouré de son petit cercle $U_i$ marqué des points $R_i^{\pm}$, $S_i^{\pm}$ et des arcs $a_i^{++}, a_i^{+-}, \dots$ ; sur l'équateur les points $Q_0$, $Q_1$, $Q_\infty$ et les arcs orientés $b_i^{\pm}$ ; des pôles partent les méridiens portant les arcs $c_i^{\pm}$ (vers les $Q_i$) et $d_i^{\pm}$ (vers les $S_i$), en traits pleins ou pointillés selon l'hémisphère.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians, equatorial vertices and holes
drawings.notes: Pencil outline; P^+ and P^-; on the equator Q_1, Q_infty, Q_0 and the three holes R_0, R_infty, R_1, each in its small circle U_i with R_i^+-, S_i^+-; the oriented arcs b_i^+- along the equator (dotted at the back), the meridians d_i^+- (to the S_i) and c_i^+- (to the Q_i), solid or dotted as on the page. The many small labels a_i^{++}, a_i^{+-}, ... round the circles are overinked; only the legible ones are placed. The circle round R_1 is at the right edge of the figure and partly cut by the crop of his own strokes.

drawings.description: deux sphères en marge. Sur la première, $\widetilde{\Sigma}_\varepsilon$ : $P_\varepsilon$ au sommet, les trois incisions $d$ menant aux points $S_i^{\varepsilon'}$, $S_j^{\varepsilon'}$, $S_k^{\varepsilon'}$ des trous, en trait épais. Sur la seconde, $\widetilde{\Sigma}_i$ : $Q_i$, $Q_j$, $R_i^{\omega}$ et les incisions le long de l'équateur.
drawings.kind: two spheres with incisions
drawings.notes: Top sphere tilde Sigma_epsilon: P_epsilon at the top, the three small circles of the holes on the equator, and the incisions in thick strokes, which on the page run up from P_epsilon' at the bottom to the points S^{epsilon'} (the transcription has them from P_epsilon). Bottom sphere tilde Sigma_i: the thick incision along the equator through Q_k, R_i^omega, Q_j, the point Q_i below it. Small labels placed as read; S_k^{epsilon'} and the lower R labels are uncertain.
drawings.disagreement: 03-2: on the page the thick incisions of the first sphere start from the bottom pole P_epsilon', not from P_epsilon at the top.

drawings.description: le graphe d'un octaèdre : $P_\varepsilon$ en haut, $P_{\varepsilon'}$ en bas, $Q_i$, $Q_j$, $Q_k$ sur l'équateur, chaque $P$ relié à chaque $Q$.
drawings.kind: bipyramid graph (octahedron sketch)
drawings.notes: P_epsilon at the top, P_epsilon' at the bottom, Q_i (left), Q_k (right) and Q_j (back, under a crossed-out scribble) on the equator; each P joined to each Q, the equator partly dashed. The crossed-out scribble near Q_j is not drawn. Not encoded: the sketch does not fix whether the equatorial edges belong to the figure.

drawings.description: en marge, un petit schéma : $P_\varepsilon$ relié par un lacet $l_0$ au trou $R_{\omega i} \simeq R_0$ (d'orientation $\varpi = \omega \wedge \varepsilon$), au point $Q_\infty$ et au trou $R_{\omega' i} \simeq R_1$.
drawings.kind: small loop diagram between holes
drawings.notes: P_epsilon at the left; the hole R_{omega i} = R_0 at the top right (circle), Q_infty in the middle, the hole R_{omega' i} = R_1 at the bottom (circle); the loop l_0 from P_epsilon round these points. The marginal labels are small and partly illegible; they are placed as the transcription reads them.

drawings.description: une sphère : $P_\varepsilon \simeq P_{+}$ au sommet, $P_{\varepsilon'}$ en bas ; le quadrilatère $\widetilde{D}_r$ hachuré entre le méridien de $Q_i \simeq Q_\infty$ et celui du trou $R_{\omega i} \simeq R_1$ ; autour des trous les points $R_{\omega i}^{\omega}$, $S_i^{\varepsilon} \simeq S_0^{\varepsilon}$, $Q_{\omega' i}$ ; légende $r = (i, \omega, \varepsilon)$, $J = \ldots$
drawings.kind: sphere with a hatched quadrilateral
drawings.notes: Pencil outline; P_epsilon = P_+ at the top, P_epsilon' at the bottom; the vertical arrow from P_epsilon to Q_i = Q_infty, the meridian down to the hole R_{omega i} = R_1 on the left, the hatched quadrilateral tilde D_r between them; the small circles round the holes on the equator. The labels round the left hole are overinked: they are placed as the transcription reads them. The legend r = (i, omega, epsilon), J = ... on the right is drawn as text only in part (it runs off the crop). The label inside the hatched region reads like a tilde I_r with a struck stroke; the transcription reads tilde D_r.

drawings.description: En haut à gauche, une sphère : pôle nord $P_+$, pôle sud $P_-$ ; sur l'équateur, de gauche à droite, $Q_1$, $R_0^-$, $R_0^+$, $Q_\infty$, $R_1^-$ ; deux petits cercles sur l'équateur, l'un entre $R_0^-$ et $R_0^+$ (avec $S_0^+$ au-dessus, $S_0^-$ au-dessous), l'autre près de $R_1^-$ (avec $S_1^+$) ; des méridiens joignent $P_+$ à $P_-$ ; un fuseau hachuré sous $P_+$, marqué d'une flèche circulaire d'orientation.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians, small circles and a hatched lune
drawings.notes: Pencil outline; P_+ at the top, P_- at the bottom; meridians from P_+ (inked) to the equator and on to P_-; on the equator, left to right, Q_1, R_0^-, R_0^+, Q_infty, R_1^-; a small circle between R_0^- and R_0^+ (S_0^- below), another near R_1^- (S_1^+ above), and a small ring above R_0^+. The hatched lune under P_+ with its circular orientation arrow. The lower half is faint and only partly drawn.

drawings.description: En marge gauche : deux petits cercles, aux points $R^{\omega}_{\omega i}$ et $R^{\omega'}_{\omega' i}$, joints par un chemin fléché $\widetilde{b}_i^{\omega}$ qui passe par $Q_i$.
drawings.kind: path between two small circles
drawings.notes: Two small circles at R^omega_{omega i} (left) and R^{omega'}_{omega' i} (right, cut by the edge of the drawing), joined by the thick path tilde b_i^omega through Q_i. No arrowhead is legible on the page; none is drawn.

drawings.description: Première figure. Trois petits cercles autour de $0$, $1$, $\infty$, deux sommets sur chacun ; les arcs des cercles portent $\lambda^0_+, \lambda^0_-$, $\lambda^1_+, \lambda^1_-$, $\lambda^\infty_+, \lambda^\infty_-$ ; trois chemins $a^1$ (de $\infty$ vers $0$), $a^\infty$ (de $0$ vers $1$), $a^0$ (de $1$ vers $\infty$). Légende : « 6 sommets, 9 flèches, \struck{1} 2 relations ».
drawings.kind: quiver on the sphere minus three points (small circles and paths)
drawings.notes: Three small oriented circles round 0, 1, infinity, two vertices on each, arcs lambda^i_+- ; paths a^1 (infinity to 0), a^infty (0 to 1), a^0 (1 to infinity). Legend "6 sommets, 9 fleches, 2 relations" in the margin (his struck "1" before "2" left out).

drawings.description: Deuxième figure. Même sphère ; un seul sommet sur chacun des cercles de $0$ et $\infty$, deux sur celui de $1$ ; flèches $\Lambda^\infty_+$, $\Lambda^0_+$, $\lambda^1_+$, $\lambda^1_-$, $a^\infty$ (de $0$ vers $1$), $a^0$ (de $1$ vers $\infty$). Légende : « 4 sommets, 1 relation, 6 flèches » ; dessous : « 3 cas ».
drawings.kind: quiver on the sphere minus three points (small circles and paths)
drawings.notes: One vertex on the circles of 0 and infinity, two on that of 1; arrows Lambda^infty_+, Lambda^0_+ (whole circles), lambda^1_+-, a^infty (0 to 1), a^0 (1 to infinity); a pencil loop surrounds the figure. Legends "4 sommets, 1 relation, 6 fleches" and "3 cas".

drawings.description: Troisième figure, biffée de traits en zigzag : cercles autour de $\infty$, $0$, $1$, un chemin de $1$ vers $\infty$ et un de $0$ vers $1$ ; au-dessus, « 1 cas ».
drawings.kind: quiver on the sphere minus three points, struck
drawings.notes: Struck through with zigzag strokes (drawn grey, style struck): circles round infinity, 1 (top) and 0 (bottom left), a path from 1 to infinity and one from 0 round to 1. "1 cas" above. The zigzag itself is drawn schematically.

drawings.description: Quatrième figure. Cercles autour de $0$ et $1$, un chemin $a^\infty$ de $0$ vers $1$, le point $\infty$ isolé dans un petit cercle. Inscriptions $\Lambda^0_+ = (\Lambda^0_-)^{-1}$, $\Lambda'^1_- = (\Lambda'^1_+)^{-1}$. Légende : « 2 sommets, trois flèches, 0 relation » ; dessous : « 3 cas ».
drawings.kind: quiver on the sphere minus three points (small circles and paths)
drawings.notes: Circles round 0 and 1 with the path a^infty from 0 to 1; infinity isolated in a small pencil circle; a pencil loop round the figure. Inscriptions Lambda^0_+ = (Lambda^0_-)^{-1}, Lambda'^1_- = (Lambda'^1_+)^{-1}; legends "2 sommets, trois fleches, 0 relation" and "3 cas".

drawings.description: Cinquième figure. Un seul sommet sur le cercle de $0$, un chemin vers le cercle de $1$ (étiquette raturée), le point $\infty$ isolé ; flèches $\Lambda^+_0$ et $\Lambda^{01}_+$. Légende : « 1 sommet, 2 flèches, 0 relation » ; dessous : « 3 cas. »
drawings.kind: quiver on the sphere minus three points (small circles and paths)
drawings.notes: One vertex on the circle of 0, a doubled path to the circle of 1; infinity isolated in a pencil circle; a pencil loop round the figure. Arrows Lambda^+_0 and Lambda^{01}_+; the label on the path is overinked (struck) and left out. Legends "1 sommet, 2 fleches", "0 relation", "3 cas".

drawings.description: Au crayon, deux sphères. La première : pôles $0$ (en haut) et $\infty$ (en bas), méridiens et équateur ; sur l'équateur, quatre petits cercles orientés autour de $1$, $i$, $-1$, $-i$ (étiquettes partiellement lisibles), reliés aux pôles par des chemins fléchés, certains en pointillé.
drawings.kind: sphere with poles, meridians and small oriented circles
drawings.notes: In pencil: outline, the pole circles 0 (top) and infinity (bottom), the equator (back half dashed), four small oriented circles on the equator; arrowed paths from the top pole down to the circles (two seen, solid; two hidden, dashed) and thin meridians down to the bottom pole. Labels: "1" at the left circle and "i" at the front one are legible; the right one reads like "-1"; the back circle is unlabelled (-i by elimination). The formula "1 -> F_2^2" on the right is text, not drawn.

drawings.description: La seconde sphère : petit cercle orienté autour du pôle supérieur et autour de $\infty$ en bas ; sur l'équateur, cercles autour de $1$ et $-1$, points $-i$ et $i$ ; chemins marqués $\beta$, « $\beta$ relevé », « $\gamma$ relevé » (deux fois), le dernier avec la mention « $\gamma$ relevé, symétrique de \ill{} ».
drawings.kind: sphere with pole circles, equatorial circles and lifted paths
drawings.notes: In pencil and ink: outline, a small oriented circle round the upper pole and one round infinity at the bottom; the dashed equator with the circles round 1 (left) and -1 (right) and the points -i, i; the meridians and the paths marked beta (with a tilde above, a bar on the right), "beta releve" (twice), "gamma releve" and "gamma releve, symetrique de ..." (the last word illegible, left out). The label at the upper pole reads like infinity as well; it is left unlabelled, as in the transcription. The formula on the right (l_infty l_1 l_0 ...) is text, not drawn.

drawings.description: Partie retournée. Une sphère avec pôles $0$ et $\infty$, l'équateur passant par $1$, quatre petits cercles sur l'équateur ($a$, $b$ marqués) ; deux flèches en partent vers le bas, avec la légende « division par $D$ (multiplication par les \ill{} \uncertain{$R_s$}) ». Une seconde flèche « division par $D^+$ (\uncertain{multiplication} \ill{} \uncertain{sur} $(0, \infty)$) » mène à une sphère dont l'équateur passe par $1$.
drawings.kind: spheres with marked circles and arrows (upside-down half of the sheet)
drawings.notes: Upside-down half of p. 109, redrawn upright. Left: sphere with poles 0 (top) and infinity (bottom), dashed central meridian, the equator through 1, four small circles near the equator (a, b marked); two arrows go down from it, with the legend "division par D (multiplication par les ... R_s)" (drawn as text, the illegible word left out). Right: the arrow "division par D^+ (...)" and the sphere at the top right, with the pole circle infinity and the inked equator passing through 1 (ringed); on the page the D^+ arrow points rather to the central sphere (06-9) than to this one. Small labels and the faint pencil meridians are approximate.
drawings.orientation: upside down on the page (tete-beche half); crop rotated 180 degrees, redraw upright, coordinates in the rotated crop

figures.what: sphere with poles 0, infinity and four small circles

drawings.description: Sphère centrale, au crayon et à l'encre : sur l'équateur le point $Q_1$ près de $-1$, le cercle autour de $1$ avec $s^+_1$, $s^-_1$, $a^{++}_1$, $a^{+-}_1$ ; chemins $b^+_1$, $b^-_1$ vers les cercles des pôles ($R^-_\infty$, $a^-_\infty$, $R^+_\infty$, $a^+_\infty$) ; inscriptions $d^+_1 (c^+_1)^{-1}$, $(a^-_1 a^+_1)^{-1}$, $d^-_1 (c^-_1)^{-1}$ ; un axe traverse la sphère, une flèche de rotation à côté.
drawings.kind: sphere with equatorial band, small circles and paths
drawings.notes: Upside-down half of p. 109, redrawn upright. Pencil outline; the pole circles (top: R_infty^-, a_infty^+-; bottom: R_infty^+, a_infty^+-); the inked closed band along the equator through Q_1 (near -1) and round the circle of 1 with s_1^+-, a_1^{++}, a_1^{+-}; dashed paths b_1^+ and b_1^- from Q_1 to the pole circles; the inscriptions d_1^+(c_1^+)^{-1}, (a_1^- a_1^+)^{-1}, d_1^-(c_1^-)^{-1}; the axis through the sphere and the rotation arrow beside it. Which inscription is attached to which stroke is a reading.
drawings.orientation: upside down on the page (tete-beche half); crop rotated 180 degrees, redraw upright, coordinates in the rotated crop

drawings.description: Sphère inférieure : pôles marqués $-\zeta$ et $-\bar\zeta$ (lecture incertaine), cercles autour de $\infty$ (point $R^+_\infty$), de $0$ (point $R_0$) et de $1$ ; chemins $c^\pm_1$, $d^\pm_1$, $b^\pm_1$, $a^{\pm\pm}_1$, $s^\pm_1$, le point $Q_1$. À côté : « \uncertain{stable} par \uncertain{symétrie} \uncertain{autour} de l'axe ».
drawings.kind: sphere with small circles and paths
drawings.notes: Upside-down half of p. 109, redrawn upright. Pencil outline and equator; the poles (labels read like -zeta with a bar at the top and -zeta at the bottom, uncertain as in the transcription); the inked circle round infinity with R_infty^+, the circle round 0 with R_0, the pencil circle round 1 with s_1^+-, a_1^{+-+-}; Q_1 near -1; the thick arrow b_1^- from Q_1 to R_infty^+, dashed paths c_1^+-, d_1^+- to the poles. The note "stable par symetrie autour de l'axe" on the right is left as text (its reading is uncertain).
drawings.orientation: upside down on the page (tete-beche half); crop rotated 180 degrees, redraw upright, coordinates in the rotated crop

drawings.description: À gauche, deux sphères raturées ; sur la seconde, les points $0$, $1$, $\infty$ sur un équateur, une moitié hachurée. À côté, la table $0, \infty \mapsto \infty$, $1 \mapsto 0$, $-1 \mapsto 1$.
drawings.kind: two struck spheres and a table
drawings.notes: Upside-down half of p. 109, redrawn upright. Two spheres crossed out: the first with its inked equator and a small circle (drawn, with grey strike strokes over it), the second with 0, infinity, 1 on the equator and the half between them hatched; the struck strokes below it grey. Beside them the table 0, infinity -> infinity, 1 -> 0, -1 -> 1 and an arrow. The scribbles are drawn schematically.
drawings.orientation: upside down on the page (tete-beche half); crop rotated 180 degrees, redraw upright, coordinates in the rotated crop

drawings.description: Au crayon, trois bandes concentriques qui figurent le revêtement au-dessus de $\Sigma$ ; on y lit les points $Q_1$, $Q_2$, $Q_3$ (marqués d'une croix), $Q^{\omega'}_1$, $Q^{\omega^2}_1$, $Q^{\omega'}_3$, $Q^{\omega}_3$, et, autour de chaque trou $R_i$, les points $R_{i,\omega}$, $R_{i,\omega'}$, $\tilde R_i$, $-\tilde R_i$, $R^\omega_i$, $R^{\omega'}_i$, $-R^\omega_i$, $-R^{\omega'}_i$. Autour de $R_1$ et de $R_2$, à l'encre, de petits quadrilatères de flèches courbes reliant ces points.
drawings.kind: covering of the sphere drawn as concentric bands, with marked points
drawings.notes: Three concentric pencil bands (the covering over Sigma), drawn as three ellipses; Q_1, Q_2, Q_3 as crosses, Q_1^{omega'}, Q_1^{omega^2}, Q_3^{omega'}, Q_3^omega; round each hole R_i the points R_{i,omega}, R_{i,omega'}, tilde R_i, -tilde R_i, R_i^omega, R_i^{omega'}, -R_i^omega, -R_i^{omega'} (those legible are labelled); round R_1 and R_2 the inked small quadrilaterals of curved arrows, drawn schematically. The band outlines are faint and doubled on the page; their exact course is approximate. Several small labels are placed only approximately.

The label of the fourth point is cut by the page and is inferred; the fifth reads R_3^omega on the page, so on the page the pair R_3 appears in the order omega', omega, against the transcription's R^omega_3, R^{omega'}_3.

The overinked centre (many short arrows) is reduced to a few curved arrows, and the outline is approximate. The prose in the left margin is not drawn.
